purpose: Keep local GitHub publication decisions explicit by separating configured remote state from push readiness.

readinessLevels.meaning: The intended GitHub remote exists in local git config.
The working tree is clean, branch target is seis/product-experience-suite, upstream is origin/seis/product-experience-suite, GitHub auth is ready, and push approval exists.
Publish preflight is ready and the server/deployment target has explicit domain, path, owner, and rollback confirmation.
allows: release artifact upload after human confirmation

currentEnvironmentPolicy.reason: This execution environment can configure and validate the remote locally, but publication remains blocked until the scoped SEIS branch state, clean worktree, GitHub authentication, and human push approval are proven.

rollback: If the GitHub target changes, reset origin and update this contract before any push or deployment claim.
